decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensing module that fits the firm's modular automation and measurement platform, the indoor air quality sensor broadens an attractive application area with no sign yet that it should be withdrawn.

The voltage measurement module is an updated hardware generation that explicitly replaces an older version, so keeping it is consistent with the firm's iterative product strategy and core measurement use cases.
The MQTT software proxy strengthens connectivity and software integration for IoT projects at relatively low ongoing cost, making it strategically valuable for the platform.
A CAN bus interface module extends the platform into industrial, robotics, and vehicle-related communication applications that match the firm's developer and company customer base.
The carbon dioxide sensor module addresses clear demand in environmental monitoring, building control, and education, and complements the firm's existing sensing portfolio.
The touch panel accessory supports prototyping and user-interface building within the modular system, so it is worth retaining while the recently launched product line matures.
